title: Iron Tests (TIBC)
attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
measures: TIBC, total iron-binding capacity, measures how well iron binds to transferrin and other proteins in the blood. It is reported alongside serum iron as part of an iron panel.
low: MedlinePlus does not describe low TIBC results on this page. It lists iron deficiency anemia, another anemia or thalassemia among the meanings of a low iron result.
high: MedlinePlus does not describe high TIBC results on this page. It lists hemochromatosis, lead poisoning or liver disease among the meanings of a high iron result.
notes: TIBC is interpreted together with serum iron and ferritin rather than alone. Iron levels vary during the day and can be affected by medicines.
